description: Prevent Frame Helm import-time failure by removing Object.freeze calls around ES module namespace objects in the Native Adapter while preserving the frozen outer adapter namespace.

operations.search:
contract:
      Object.freeze(contract),

    actors:
      Object.freeze(actors),

    items:
      Object.freeze(items),

    loadout:
      Object.freeze(loadout),

    resources:
      Object.freeze(resources),

    status:
      Object.freeze(status),

    rolls:
      Object.freeze(rolls),

    combat:
      Object.freeze(combat),

    execution:
      Object.freeze(execution)
operations.replace:
contract,
    actors,
    items,
    loadout,
    resources,
    status,
    rolls,
    combat,
    execution
